title: David and Jonathan
textBlocks:
Best friends make a plan
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible lesson
you will hear what good friends 
David and Jonathan are

David tells Jonathan that King Saul, Jonathan’s dad
wants to hurt him
Jonathan does NOT believe David
So they come up with a plan to see if David is RIGHT or Jonathan is RIGHT
THE PLAN INVOLVES A BOW AND ARROWS and a secret MESSAGE
